### ls-simple | kinds=read | flags=
ls -la

### journalctl-read | kinds=read | flags=
journalctl -u nginx --since today --no-pager

### systemctl-status | kinds=read | flags=
systemctl status nginx

### systemctl-restart | kinds=write | flags=
systemctl restart nginx

### chain-and | kinds=read,write | flags=
ls -la && systemctl restart nginx

### chain-or | kinds=read,read | flags=
ls /nonexistent || true

### chain-semicolon | kinds=read,read | flags=
uptime; free -h

### pipe-sort | kinds=read,read | flags=
df -h | sort -k5 -n

### docker-ps | kinds=read | flags=
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

### rm-write | kinds=write | flags=
rm -rf /tmp/synthetic-dir

### docker-run | kinds=write | flags=
docker run --rm alpine true

### newline-split | kinds=read,read | flags=
ls -la
df -h

### systemctl-failed | kinds=read
systemctl --failed

### hostnamectl-read | kinds=read
hostnamectl

### hostnamectl-write | kinds=write
hostnamectl set-hostname web01

### timedatectl-write | kinds=write
timedatectl set-timezone UTC

### lsb-release | kinds=read
lsb_release -a
